name: Kaguyahime
source: A Chishiki Girl who was lost but then found. She has a carefree personality but can be quite firm when it comes to the other Chishiki Girls, and rides a big vehicle called "Bamboo No. 1" both when she moves and fights, rarely moving her body on her own. She quickly responds to both words "useless" and "inactive" quite negatively and fast.
